title: Sundown Quietcraft release ops notes and smoke lab
content:
Purpose:
This is an operational sketch for a low-impact evening release ("quiet window") we nicknamed "Quietcraft". Goal: ship model-routing and small batching improvements to serving runtime with minimal customer-visible risk. Use this doc as the single source for on-call & operator actions during the 6-hour window.

TL;DR:
- Window: 2025-03-20 22:00–04:00 UTC (6h)
- Target canary cohort: 2% global traffic -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (if green)
- Primary rollback triggers: 95th p50 latency > 220ms above baseline OR error-rate spike > 0.5% sustained for 5m
- Quick smoke checklist below; run smoke lab scripts in order 1..6

Rollout calendar (hourly cadence):
- 22:00 UTC: preflight check + deploy canary (2%) to us-west-1 and eu-west-1 canaries only
- 22:15: run smoke-lab-1 (sanity + kv-cache warmup)
- 22:30: observe 15m metrics, run function-based regression prompts (set A)
- 23:00: escalate to 10% if green, run smoke-lab-2 (latency probes, sample logs)
- 00:00: observe 30m window, adjust batching knobs if bursty
- 01:00: 25% cohort -> run synthetic traffic ramp (10k qps for 5m) on staging mirror
- 02:00: 50% cohort -> run smoke-lab-3 (end-to-end inference scenarios)
- 03:00: decision meeting (observability & SRE) -> either continue to 100% or roll back
- 04:00: finalize notes & tagging, start 72h close monitoring

Preflight checklist (quick):
- [ ] All rolling-runbooks synced with on-call (Slack #release-runway pinned)
- [ ] Canary image built and promoted (GHA artifact id recorded)
- [ ] Baseline telemetry snapshot saved (metrics tag: "pre-sundown-20250320")
- [ ] Ops tokens available and documented (KMS path verified)
- [ ] DB schema/no-migration items: none
- [ ] Feature flags created and ready to flip (flag keys: routing.new-squeeze, batching.dynamic)
- [ ] Alerting mute windows set for non-critical noise events

Smoke lab scripts (order and intent):
1) smoke-lab-1.sh -> KV warmup + simple gen (prompt set: sanity-10)
2) smoke-lab-2.sh -> tail-latency probes against tail shards + log-sample collection
3) smoke-lab-3.sh -> long-context regression (2x seq len)
4) smoke-lab-4.sh -> token-accuracy quick eval (5 prompts from eval-corpus A)
5) smoke-lab-5.sh -> token-cost sampling to validate cost counter stability
6) smoke-lab-meta.sh -> collect traces with x-trace-id and upload to S3 for postmortem

Observability knobs & dashboards to watch:
- Primary: release/latency-over-time (p50/p90/p95), release/error-rate, release/cpu-utilization
- Secondary: prefix-cache-hit-rate, batching/avg-batch-size, kv-cache-miss-per-min
- Dashboards: "Quietcraft watch" (tile ids: qc-001, qc-002), traces: sample by x-trace-id prefix QC
- Quick queries: "sum(rate(errors[1m])) by region" and "histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(latency_bucket[5m]))"

Rollback criteria (fast):
- Immediate rollback: sustained total 5xx increase of +0.5% over baseline for 5m OR p95 latency regression > +220ms for 10m
- Soft rollback: unusual memory growth on any serving node >80% for 10m
- If rollback: revert feature flags first, then scale down canaries, then redeploy previous image if flags flip doesn't resolve

Communication plan:
- Primary channel: #release-runway (ops & owners), backchannel: #sre-hotline for postmortem threads
- Pager escalation: SRE on-call -> Release lead -> Eng manager -> CTO (if Sev 1)
- Customer comms: draft release note (below) saved to CONFLUENCE and product-comms will decide whether to notify enterprise customers

Draft release notes (internal -> external candidate):
- Internal summary: "Low-risk rollout of dynamic batching and model-routing 'squeeze' optimization to improve p95 token latency for long-context queries. Initial rollout targeted evening quiet window. No customer-facing changes expected."
- Public-facing blurb (candidate): "We deployed an optimization to reduce latency for long-context generation on select endpoints. You may notice small improvements in response times. No action required."
- Changelog bullets: routing.new-squeeze: opt-in flag enabled on canaries; batching.dynamic: server-side heuristic tweak; telemetry: added qc.metrics.batch_size

Post-release tasks:
- Save full telemetry snapshot with tag post-sundown-20250320
- Run 24h and 72h regression checks against eval-corpus B (daily run)
- Create a short retro note in this doc with bullet issues + owner within 48h

Open questions / notes-to-self:
- Should we enable per-region backpressure at 10% or wait until 25%? (Asha to decide)
- Consider adding an automated throttle that pauses routing.new-squeeze when cpu spike >85% (Riley follow-up)
- Make smoke-lab scripts idempotent and safe to run multiple times; current tmp files leak in /tmp/smoke-*

Attachments & quick refs:
- Smoke scripts in repo: github.com/org/repo/tree/main/ops/smoke-labs
- Canary artifact: ghcr.io/redwood/canary/20250320-qc (ensure tag is immutable)
- Postmortem template: CONFLUENCE:postmortems/template-v2

-- Maya (release lead)
Notes: this is intentionally lean — keep the on-call checklist short and the rollback path obvious. Add any small local runbook snippets under the team Confluence page and link them back here after the run.
